title: unionclef 0.95.48
subtitle: food and zombies: either eat or fight
caption: unionclef 0.95.48: a hungry bot no longer flip-flops between eating and running from a mob. The enemy check for food only saw mobs within melee range; now the bot eats while the enemy is far and kills a winnable mob once it closes in. github.com/3ndetz/unionclef/releases/tag/v0.95.48

segments.title: Course mob_hungry
lines: night, one zombie ten blocks away
correct: eat before it arrives, or kill it and eat

segments.title: Before: 0.95.47
segments.caption: food in hand, the bot runs from the zombie, only fights after 30 seconds

segments.title: After
segments.caption: finishes eating while the zombie is far, then kills it once it closes in

segments.title: Bites taken per meal
segments.note: mob_hungry, 5 runs after the fix; 0 damage

segments.title: What was wrong
lines: the enemy check only saw mobs within melee range
the 7 and 14 block thresholds were swapped
without armor the bot ran even from a zombie it could beat
the agent's getEntitiesInfo tool saw the world just as narrowly
